instrumentation: In-memory AST copy of the existing DP; one reporting callback per completed location. Original solver source unchanged.
timing: Starts after phase loading and threshold conversion; includes DP option construction, DP transitions, reconstruction and reporting overhead. Timed out cases have no reported optimum.
memory: Peak RSS of each isolated worker process. Checked every 20 ms; cutoff can overshoot between checks.
states: Counts refer only to completed location layers; the interrupted layer can contain additional states.
limitations: One seeded case per family/dimension is a feasibility probe, not a representative statistical scalability study.
